verdict.rationale: Devin's docs mention permission systems for MCP tools with control 'at multiple levels' (devin-docs-13) and various handoff/takeover workflows (web draft to IDE, interactive browser jump-in, terminal watch), which imply some graduated human-in-the-loop control, but there is no documented concept of engineering-lead-configurable 'tiered autonomy levels' as an organizational policy setting. missing for 10: explicit tiered autonomy/permission-level configuration for leads, org-wide policy controls on agent action scope, independent verification that these controls work as described.
